user.title: Health Assistant
user.description: Set up Health Assistant. All health data stays local to this Home Assistant instance.

sources.title: Choose your sources
sources.description:
Choose the account that belongs to you for each metric. This health history is for one person. Your choice becomes the first source in that metric's priority order. Existing manual mappings stay active. Changing accounts replaces that integration's mappings but keeps its recorded history. Readings start from the current sensor state; past history is not imported.

{source_details}

manual.title: Manual entity mapping
manual.description: Use existing sensors for sources without an automatic map. Readings are captured from the current sensor state and future updates; past history is not imported.

create_backup.name: Create backup
create_backup.description: Writes a consistent timestamped copy of the local health database into the integration's backups folder.

database_corrupt.title: Health database cannot be opened
database_corrupt.description: The health database at {path} is corrupt or unreadable and Health Assistant refused to start rather than reset it. The file has not been modified. Restore a backup over it, or move it aside to start fresh, then reload the integration. Error: {error}

database_unsupported_version.title: Health database is from a newer version
database_unsupported_version.description: The health database at {path} was created by a newer version of Health Assistant. The file has not been modified. Upgrade the integration, or restore a backup that matches this version, then reload the integration. Error: {error}
